+
+#ifndef AVCODEC_APV_H
+#define AVCODEC_APV_H
+
+// Signature value in APV bitstreams (section 5.3.1).
+#define APV_SIGNATURE MKBETAG('a', 'P', 'v', '1')
+
+// PBU types (section 5.3.3).
+enum {
+    APV_PBU_PRIMARY_FRAME           = 1,
+    APV_PBU_NON_PRIMARY_FRAME       = 2,
+    APV_PBU_PREVIEW_FRAME           = 25,
+    APV_PBU_DEPTH_FRAME             = 26,
+    APV_PBU_ALPHA_FRAME             = 27,
+    APV_PBU_ACCESS_UNIT_INFORMATION = 65,
+    APV_PBU_METADATA                = 66,
+    APV_PBU_FILLER                  = 67,
+};
+
+// Format parameters (section 4.2).
+enum {
+    APV_MAX_NUM_COMP = 4,
+    APV_MB_WIDTH     = 16,
+    APV_MB_HEIGHT    = 16,
+    APV_TR_SIZE      = 8,
+};
+
+// Chroma formats (section 4.2).
+enum {
+    APV_CHROMA_FORMAT_400  = 0,
+    APV_CHROMA_FORMAT_422  = 2,
+    APV_CHROMA_FORMAT_444  = 3,
+    APV_CHROMA_FORMAT_4444 = 4,
+};
+
+// Coefficient limits (section 5.3.15).
+enum {
+    APV_BLK_COEFFS      = (APV_TR_SIZE * APV_TR_SIZE),
+    APV_MIN_TRANS_COEFF = -32768,
+    APV_MAX_TRANS_COEFF =  32767,
+};
+
+// Profiles (section 10.1.3).
+enum {
+    APV_PROFILE_422_10  = 33,
+    APV_PROFILE_422_12  = 44,
+    APV_PROFILE_444_10  = 55,
+    APV_PROFILE_444_12  = 66,
+    APV_PROFILE_4444_10 = 77,
+    APV_PROFILE_4444_12 = 88,
+    APV_PROFILE_400_10  = 99,
+};
+
+// General level limits for tiles (section 10.1.4.1).
+enum {
+    APV_MIN_TILE_WIDTH_IN_MBS  = 16,
+    APV_MIN_TILE_HEIGHT_IN_MBS = 8,
+    APV_MAX_TILE_COLS          = 20,
+    APV_MAX_TILE_ROWS          = 20,
+    APV_MAX_TILE_COUNT         = APV_MAX_TILE_COLS * APV_MAX_TILE_ROWS,
+};
+
+// Metadata types (section 10.3.1).
+enum {
+    APV_METADATA_ITU_T_T35    = 4,
+    APV_METADATA_MDCV         = 5,
+    APV_METADATA_CLL          = 6,
+    APV_METADATA_FILLER       = 10,
+    APV_METADATA_USER_DEFINED = 170,
+};
+
+#endif /* AVCODEC_APV_H */

findings.title: Missing bounds check on tile_data_size before skipping bits in APV tile parsing (heap-buffer-overflow)
findings.message: In the CBS APV syntax template's tile() function, when reading (READ direction), the code takes comp_size = current->tile_header.tile_data_size[c] (an attacker-controlled 32-bit value parsed earlier from the bitstream by tile_header()) and immediately does current->tile_data[c] = (uint8_t*)align_get_bits(rw); skip_bits_long(rw, 8 * comp_size); without ever verifying that the underlying bit reader actually has at least 8*comp_size bits remaining in the buffer. Because tile_data_size[c] is only bounded relative to tile_size_remaining computed from header fields (also attacker-controlled and not cross-checked against actual remaining buffer size in this code path), a crafted APV bitstream can specify a tile_data_size larger than the number of bytes actually available in the underlying buffer. skip_bits_long() will then advance the bit position past the end of the allocated buffer, and current->tile_data[c] together with the advertised comp_size is later used/copied, causing a heap-buffer-overflow (out-of-bounds read) when downstream code accesses the tile_data pointer for comp_size bytes. This was confirmed by OSS-Fuzz across the APV codec fuzzer and the APV metadata bitstream filter fuzzer.
findings.suggestion: Before advancing the bit reader with skip_bits_long(rw, 8 * comp_size) in the READ path, verify that the reader actually has that many bits left, e.g. by checking get_bits_left(rw) < 8LL * comp_size and returning AVERROR_INVALIDDATA if so (matching the ENOSPC-style bound already present in the WRITE path).

ground_truth.root_cause: The tile() syntax function in libavcodec/cbs_apv_syntax_template.c trusted the tile_data_size value derived from the bitstream's tile_header without validating it against the number of bits actually remaining in the reader (get_bits_left) before calling skip_bits_long(). The write-direction code path had an analogous check (put_bytes_left), but the equivalent check was omitted for the read-direction path when the function was first written, allowing out-of-bounds tile data ranges to be accepted silently.

must_cover.reason: Primary location of finding: Missing bounds check on tile_data_size before skipping bits in APV tile parsing (heap-buffer-overflow)
